allowed: You may use OpenRouter programmatically as an aggregator across supported upstream providers, including agent-driven use.
You may route requests to any configured model and build products on the outputs.
You must comply with each upstream provider's terms for the models you route to.
forbidden: You must not circumvent rate limits or abuse free-tier models.
You must not reverse engineer OpenRouter or the upstream models.
You must not rely on OpenRouter's terms alone: the routed upstream provider's terms also govern.
retention: Retention depends on the routed upstream provider; OpenRouter's own terms defer to upstream policies for data handling (as of the verification date).
training: Whether inputs train models is governed by the upstream provider's terms and model variant; free variants may permit training, so verify per route.
